newsitem.title: USA: Actor Charlie Sheen arrested on suspicion of assault.
newsitem.headline: Actor Charlie Sheen arrested on suspicion of assault.

text.p: Actor Charlie Sheen was arrested on Saturday after a 24-year-old woman complained that he assaulted her in his home, a sheriff's spokeswoman said.
Sheriff's Deputy Carrie Stuart said Sheen, 31, was booked on suspicion of assault and released on $20,000 bail.

Stuart said the woman, whose name was not released, told police she was with Sheen at his suburban Agoura home on Friday evening when the two became involved in a heated argument. She complained that Sheen shoved her to the floor, nearly knocking her out.
The woman later needed seven stitches to close a cut on her lower lip, Stuart added.

Stuart said the woman left Sheen's home and made her complaint at a local sheriff's station. "Based on the victim's statement, deputies obtained search and arrest warrants for Sheen and his residence that were served early (Saturday)," Stuart said.
Sheen, whose films include "Cadence," "The Three Musketeers," "Major League II," "Terminal Velocity," and "The Chase," was not immediately available for comment.
